title: Classify European bank residual shapes
changes: Classify all 41 unresolved source intervals by geometry and record direct address-shaped values at all byte phases and ROM mirrors.
validation: Static census xbrt1szy reconciles 570 bytes with E301 and E438. It records 50 alignment-shaped zero bytes and five address-shaped word cells. The first attempt ztekptbp stopped before reading inputs because the driver used its scratch directory as the repository root.
limitations: Original reader and padding semantics remain open. No extraction, runtime tests or performance measurement ran. Linux and USA remain pending.
